name: LUT vers Premiere
description: Copies LUTs into Premiere Pro's LUT folders (Adobe/Common/LUTs/Creative for looks, Input for input LUTs), which Premiere watches: no restart needed. Each LUT is written as a 64x64x64 .cube, the size Premiere resamples LUTs to, and FilmCraft renders that same table. A different file of the same name is never replaced (the copy gets ' (FilmCraft)'). Each copy is logged in premiere-luts.log in the FilmCraft data folder.
author: FilmCraft
